newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine shares recover at close on bargain buys.
newsitem.headline: Argentine shares recover at close on bargain buys.

text.p: Argentine shares closed higher Friday as buyers emerged to take advantage of low prices after an accumulated fall of 5.4 percent this week, dealers said.
Leading index Merval .MERV ended up 1.28 percent at 600.43 points while the broader general index shed 0.71 percent.
"Traders took advantage of a calmer international market climate that favoured a general rebound of prices," said Dario Lizzano, of Banco Santader.

"In coming days the local market will still be following the developed markets, where uncertainty about the imminent U.S. Federal Reserve meeting is causing less activity and less volatility in prices."
Analysts said the next resistance level for the Merval is around 605 points and the support at 585.
Volume fell steeply to $14.1 million from $28 million Thursday.
Gainers beat losers by 29 to 14 with 17 shares flat.
Main rises among blue chips were steel-maker Acindar with 4.5 percent and Sol Petroleo with 4.3 percent.
